provenance.note: Eurostat published final euro-area annual HICP inflation at 3.2 percent for August 2026 on 17 September 2026. On 2 October 2026 Eurostat published the September 2026 flash estimate at 3.8 percent, explicitly comparing it with August at 3.2 percent. The replay therefore reconstructs the information set actually available to the market: August final followed by September flash. The canonical heatmap source label is preserved while the certified adapter verifies Eurostat prc_hicp_minr directly.
